Title: Azure AD support in GitHub Enterprise

Body.Content:
To support the needs of enterprise customers, GitHub Enterprise customers can now synchronize groups of GitHub users with Azure AD and thus enforce a secure workplace identity.  Azure AD synchronization allows GitHub customers to leverage their existing Azure AD solution for group membership so that their administrators and developers can focus on their application development.

Read the blog to learn more.
